title: PAF Exception Eligibility Registry Contract (Step 8)
description: Defines which controls may be waived, which may never be, and what an emergency may and may not do. Carries no project decision IDs.

classes.description: Must include a strictly non-waivable class. A registry in which every control is waivable is not an exception registry.

globalNonWaivableInvariants.description: Invariants no exception, emergency, or approval may pierce.

decisions.description: Populated in a PROFILE instance. Every governed decision must carry an effective class; an unclassified decision is a coverage gap, not a permitted waiver.

emergencyRule.description: Must permit sequencing/timing acceleration ONLY, and must explicitly refuse to convert non-waivable controls, pierce global invariants, or manufacture approval.
